book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Pol mikme dut muwage foloŋ kameune Lomade uguk
Italide uuŋdok ninimbune Mapme Sisa’walaŋ mikme bop diniŋ talitimeŋ wou Yuliyo, adi Pol tiŋa me yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ hakiŋ noli maaŋ yanagilu muwage foloŋ logumun.
Muwage u Adalamitiumhi’walaŋ ala Esiya ime magineŋ yokwet haliulak indigoŋ wooŋ yaliudok yogiŋ doktiŋa logumun. Tesalonaika niŋ notnik niŋ wou Alistaka, adi noŋgoŋ logumun.
Heleune muwage Saidon yokwetneŋ wooŋ yakuk kaŋ Yuliyo adi Pol not timiŋa nadimimbune wooŋ noliŋiye yabune nanaŋe dumuŋ talipmeŋ nanaŋdok miŋgiŋ.
Kaŋ une tugumun iŋgoŋ fifiŋ indi ugumuneŋkade fedikuk doktiŋa indi Saipalas kwet kambaŋgit eŋ Esiya kwet lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ ugumun.
Wooŋ Silisiya eŋ Pamfiliya ime magi hogok wooŋ Lisiya kwetneŋ Maila yokwetneŋ wosuwagumun.
Uŋoŋ wooŋ mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋdi Alesandiliyahi’walaŋ muwage niŋ Italide we tuguk kaŋ ninimbu uŋgoŋ logumun.
Wooŋ baigoŋ baigoŋ uŋila melenai fee kaŋ Naidas yokwet tubudulagumun. Kaŋ fifiŋ adi uuŋ tine ugumuneŋkade buguk doktiŋa udaneeŋ Kilit kwet kambaŋgitkade ugumun.
Wooŋ kwet mimim niŋ wou Salmoni u kalakapmendok kwanaimiŋ tige tige ime wou “Muwage Falik Momooŋ” yoiŋ uŋoŋ wosuwagumun. Kwet u Lasia yokwet wapum halu yamaiŋgoŋ hatak.
Imeŋgwaŋ foloŋ nai fee hinek hatigumun doktiŋa gwi sububa nai agaŋ dula hinek tuguk
kaŋ Poldi mede niniŋkiliti indiŋ tuguk,
“Mewoi, kobuk i tomboyoula unim adi kadakaniŋ hinek kalat. Muwage kadakaune bomboŋ ime maaneŋ foneeŋ, tiŋa me noli hatihatihik uŋoŋ binek dapmawaak.”
Unduŋ yoguk iŋgoŋ mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋ adi Pol’walaŋ mede mu nadiguk. Adi muwage molom eŋ me muwage tubu ugumun’walaŋ mede nadiŋa kedem uuŋdok yobu ugiŋ.

Gwi sububa gineŋ muwage uŋoŋ yayatdok falik hogoli doktiŋa me fee adi Finiksde uuŋdok yogiŋ. Kwet u muwage hekidok falik uŋgoŋ hatuguk, u Kilit kwet uŋoŋ. Ime u kwet fukufukuŋdi fifiŋ kamehep tubune kedem hatak doktiŋa sifo nai u uŋoŋ itoudok yogiŋ.
Fifiŋgobut wapum tiŋa imedi muwage youbulagineguk
Kaŋ fifiŋ siginik gineŋkade baigoŋ baigoŋ fedilune me muwage foloŋ kwanai tagiŋ adi uuŋdok yoŋa aŋga hamaneu labuguk, kaŋ Kilit ime magi hogok kelegumun.
Ila wanewane fifiŋ kweboboe gineŋkade fedikuk. Fifiŋ wou maniune, ala kwet kambaŋgit gineŋkade tububihila fedikuk.
Fedila buŋa muwage fedininiŋeneune tubu-udanedok moŋ tiŋa kaŋ binene fifiŋdi fedila nagi uguk.
Wooŋ kwet kambaŋgit niŋ wou Kauda uŋoŋ wooŋ muwage wapum’walaŋ kuyaniŋŋiŋ niŋdi ime maaneŋ fowe tubu kwanaimiŋ tiŋa hamantine loune ibikilitiŋa mindaŋkade
muwage wapumbo tawawaakneŋ yoŋa tawa moŋgo ibikilitigumun. Unduŋ tiŋa Siliti kwet uŋoŋ ime wahiŋgoŋ gineŋ loneemneŋ yoŋa seli-kabe fiyalu fofoyeune fifiŋdi fedila nagi uguk.
Heleune fifiŋgobut undiniŋgoŋ tuguk doktiŋa bomboŋ noli moŋgo ime gineŋ yakukiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa bufaaŋ heleune muwage diniŋ bomboŋ noli moŋgo yakulu ime gineŋ fogiŋ.
Helebufa fee hinek fifiŋgobut undiniŋ hogok tubune mele be bamholiŋa nemu mintaune yabugumun, doktiŋa agaŋ kumuŋdapmanim hogok nadidapmaaŋ ikumun.

Unduŋ tiŋa me nanaŋe map ila uune Poldi lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ pilali yali yeniŋguk, “Mewoi, hidi nu’walaŋ medene nadine tiŋit binek Kilit ime magineŋ uŋoŋ hatiyanim, kaŋ nemek malabumuŋ indiniŋ mu mintanimuluwek.
Fiit saŋiniŋ tiŋa itnim, nebek nemu kumumbek, muwagedi hogok kadakadapmawek.
Nu Bepaŋ’walaŋ tipilapilaye-me tiŋa adi hati-niutumbalat. Adigoŋ aŋeloŋiŋ kameune timiŋ buŋa
indiŋ naniŋak, ‘Pol, du munta mu tibeŋ. Du Loma Mapme’walaŋ namanda foloŋ minta hinek tibaaŋ. Bepaŋ adi momooŋ doktiŋa hehitubu-lodaune me dukut wiiŋ hogohogok kumuŋ mu tineeŋ.’
Nu Bepaŋ welelufom mu timilat, doktiŋa mede naniŋak u folooŋ undugoŋ hinek mintawaak nadilat.
Iŋgoŋ muwage adi kwet kambaŋgit niŋ gineŋ looŋ tawawaak.”
Indi Meditelenien imeŋgwaŋ foloŋ helebufa 14 wondok tuwot hatine timiŋ lekiŋgoŋ tubune me muwage foloŋ kwanai tagiŋ adi kwet agaŋ tubudulayam yo nadigiŋ.
Unduŋ yoŋa nemek malabumuŋ niŋ tawa diki foloŋ tehiŋa kapmaaŋ kagiŋ 30 mita tuguk. Kaŋ kabe-muniniŋ uyeŋ kapmaaŋ kagiŋ 20 mita hogok tuguk.
Kaŋ kawade foloŋ loneemneŋ yoŋa aŋga 4 mindaŋkade kiyapmaaŋ pilap heledok ninadi kwanai tigiŋ.
Kaŋ me muwage foloŋ kwanai tagiŋ adi momoŋ tine yonadiŋa muwage-kabe niŋ tiŋa kapmau ime gineŋ foune yalaŋ indiŋ yogiŋ, “Indi muwage mimim foloŋ aŋga neeŋ kiyapmanim.”
Yalaŋ unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ Pol adi mikme heki indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Me muwage foloŋ kwanai tiiŋ adi fooŋ momo uneŋ adi indi kumuŋ tinim.”
Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ mikme heki adi tawa dobune muwage-kabe adi imede uguk.
Agaŋ helemiŋ dobulune Pol adi pilali me indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi nanaŋe mu naaŋ hogok hatibune kadehati 14 tilak,
ale fiit nanaŋe neeŋ naaŋ fafaŋeŋ kiŋ foloŋ looŋ hatineŋ. Hidi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋ ime gineŋ nemu kumuŋa filek.”
Unduŋ yenimbu ila kaune belet niŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ wobuŋa naguk.
Unduŋ tuguk u kaŋ saŋiniŋ tiŋa me noli maaŋ nanaŋe nagiŋ.
Me muwage wondok foloŋ ugumun yokunatnik 276.
Nanaŋe nakilitiŋa bomboŋ
bethinit moŋgola ime foloŋ kutne muwage lodaaŋ labuguk.
Mele labu hautaune me muwage foloŋ kwanai tagiŋ adi kwet u daŋgoŋ hinek u mu kadakaleeŋ kwet momooŋ, kiŋnit kaŋ muwage uŋandiŋ tubudidimeune wek

yoŋa aŋga tawaŋiŋ dobudoko taugiŋ, tiŋa bem muwage tubudidimeu uuŋ diniŋ tawa u fiyakut tigiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa fifiŋdi fedila seli foloŋ siloneune muwage wooŋ ime magineŋ yalek yoŋa seli mimimneŋ u tubu loguk.
Iŋgoŋ muwage siyo adi kiŋ foloŋ looŋ youkilitiŋa waliwali mu tiŋa yalune muwage kumoi agaŋ ime saŋiniŋnitdi buŋa youbulagineune tawamunumunuke tuguk.
Kaŋ mikme heki adi me yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ yapmeŋdok heki nebek niŋ tiyaugene kiŋ foloŋ looŋ momoŋ tibaakneŋ ale widihikumuŋ titiŋdok yoŋa yohebet tigiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ talitimeŋhikdi Pol mu ulukumundok nadiguk doktiŋa unduŋ mu titiŋdok yeniŋguk. Tobo me ime kedem mopnedok nadiŋa tatakula timeŋ kedem mopneeŋ kiŋ foloŋ loloŋdok yeniŋguk.
Kaŋ me noli hogohogok mindaŋ tatakula bem muwage diniŋ gologiŋ dikidiki yohoneeŋ mopneeŋ lodapmagiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa nebek nemu kumuŋguk, indi hogohogok wanaŋ kiŋ foloŋ lodapmagumun.

footnotes.text: Gilik mede gineŋ “Nanaŋe kamehepdok nai” unduŋ yoyagiŋ. U Judahi’walaŋ nai wapum doktiŋa nanaŋe kamehep tagiŋ. Nai uŋaniŋ gwi sububa wapum tuluguk doktiŋa muwage mu yawagiŋ. Nai wapum wendiniŋ mebi Wokplis 23:27-29gineŋ youkiŋ hatak.
Bomboŋ bethinit adi pandiŋ dabugoŋ. Wou “wit” yoyagiŋ.
